Which statement about the properties of metals is correct?
A
Metals are malleable because the layers of positive ions can slide over each other.
B
Metals conduct electricity when solid because the positive ions move freely through the
metal.
C
Metals conduct electricity because there is a strong force of attraction between the positive
ions and the delocalised electrons.
D
Metals have a high melting point because the positive ions attract each other strongly.
